description: A second attribute on the same line is an error even with an interpolation six brackets deep
notes: hashicorp/hcl's error recovery after the first attribute tracks open delimiters in a slice that starts with room for eight (recoverAfterBodyItem in hclsyntax/parser.go), and the six brackets, the quote and the interpolation fill it when the interpolation closes, so this checks the error is still reported then.
